entity: 944 US for-profit nursing homes whose operating companies formed 2022 to Sept 2024 (a stand-in for recent sales), star ratings vs same-state for-profit peers
what_we_add: The 944-home cohort; 0.28 stars below same-state for-profit peers; 52% one- or two-star, 8 points above peers; median home 0.42 stars below
why: Ryskina/Penn LDI and ASPE say sold homes were already lower-rated and slip about 0.1 star after sale, but for sales through 2022, not this 2022-24 cohort, and as a pre-sale level and a before/after change, not a gap vs peers. No source names these homes; SNN retells the Penn study; the Boston Globe piece is commentary on Rhode Island homes.
